images.view: High aerial view from a distance, with the whole solar plant visible inside the frame.
images.detail: Concentric rings of tilted polished mirrors surround the tower and all face toward its top.
images.site: It stands on a flat plateau at the top of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff, open to the sky, on a lifeless alien planet of bare rock.
images.subject: A solar power plant built around one colossal central tower with a brilliantly glowing receiver at its top. On the right side of the frame, on the plateau beside the mirror field, stands a second large and clearly separate block: a thermal storage facility of several giant upright cylindrical molten-salt tanks, linked to the tower by thick insulated pipes.
